$comment: Named, time-limited exceptions for DEVELOPMENT-ONLY dependency advisories.
This file is NOT a suppression list for the production audit gate. The
production gate lives in tests/security/dependencies.test.ts, runs
`pnpm audit --json --prod`, fails on any high or critical finding, and does
not read this file. The two mechanisms are deliberately separate.
1. every entry must carry all required fields;
2. every entry must have a future review/expiry date - an expired entry
fails the suite, which forces a decision instead of silent drift;
3. an advisory is only excused if `pnpm audit` reports every one of its
findings as dev-only. A production finding is never excused here;
4. any dev-only advisory that is NOT listed here fails the suite, so a
newly introduced advisory cannot arrive unnoticed.

exceptions.title: JS-YAML: Quadratic CPU consumption in !!omap resolution — CVE-2026-59870 fix not backported
exceptions.justification: Dev-only transitive dependency reached exclusively through eslint toolchain (eslint → @eslint/eslintrc → js-yaml@4.3.0). No production exposure — js-yaml is never bundled or served. Upgrade to 4.3.1 is pinned in pnpm-workspace.yaml overrides; this exception exists until the lockfile can be regenerated on a machine with write access to node_modules.
exceptions.scope: dev tooling only — eslint static analysis, never runtime
exceptions.removalCondition: Remove once pnpm lockfile is regenerated with js-yaml ^4.3.1 override in pnpm-workspace.yaml
